title: Slow fuel (Du 2 -> 0.3) in the chi=0 condensate food chain gives a standing, spatially segregated ecology: predators alive at t=12000 on 3/3 seeds (128^2) and t=10000 at 256^2, prey divide as dumbbells (persistent splits 14/8/3, 25 at 256^2) against 0/5/1 in the predator-free twin; predators coarsen and do not divide
summary: world.py is the mixed-diet world (20261026T1200-c42-mixed-diet-predators) run with WORLD_P {"Du":0.3} (chi 0, k0 0.002). From noise, prey droplets and worm-like predator condensates form and stay in slowly shifting, segregated patches (predators in waste-rich zones, prey in fuel-rich ones; packs/du3_s0/sheet.png, packs/du3_256/sheet.png) instead of the large prey/predator cycles at Du=2. Labkit (128^2, t=12000, seeds 0-2; 256^2 t=10000 seed 0): predator components at the end 15/5/7 and 40; prey persistent splits 14/8/3 (max generation 3/2/1) and 25 (generation 2, merge/split 0.15) at 256^2, against 0/5/1 (generation 0/1/1) in the matched predator-free twin (pred_on 0, same seeds, 128^2), which is a frozen emulsion of 108-109 prey droplets; with a 500 t lineage window (seed 0) prey reach 46 persistent splits and generation 5. Predators do not reproduce: persistent splits 0 at K=20 on every run (3 at K=5), merge/split 1.6-2.5. Screen at 128^2, seed 0: Du 0.1 kills predators (t=4800); at Du 0.3 kq 0.004 and 0.006 (k2 0.3) kill them (2800, 1300), kq 0.002 keeps them; chi 0.1 at Du 0.3 kills them (5500); at Du=2, chi 0.1-0.15 keeps them to t=10000, chi 0.2 and chi 0.15 with k0 0.0025 lose them (5900, 7900).

finding.operator: slow fuel diffusion plus mixed-diet predation in a closed condensate food chain
finding.control: matched predator-free twin (pred_on 0), seeds 0-2, 128^2, t=12000; 256^2 grid check; one-seed screen of Du, kq, chi
finding.result: prey persistent splits (K=20) with predators 14, 8, 3 (128^2 s0-2), 25 (256^2 s0) vs twin 0, 5, 1; prey max generation 3, 2, 1, 2 vs 0, 1, 1; predators alive at the end on 4/4 runs (15, 5, 7, 40 components); predator persistent splits 0 on 4/4, merge/split 1.59-2.45
